answer: Spatial Ground-Truth Attestation. Each identity must periodically submit a geotagged photo of a randomly assigned physical landmark—a tundra research station, a numbered harbor jetty, an oasis well—verified against satellite imagery and a hardware secure element in a delivered device. An operator can't fake distinct locations without physically visiting each one. Per-identity cost: a device shipment plus travel to every assigned site, scaling linearly with fake identities.
